slides.author: Alexey Grigorev
slides.title: When an agent fails, logs are not enough
slides.subtitle: You need to see the exact step, tool call, model call, timing, and retry path.

slides.title: The wrong question
slides.body: If the answer is wrong, saying the model did something weird does not help. You need to know which step changed the workflow.

slides.title: Questions traces answer
slides.body: Which tool was called? What arguments were sent? What came back? Was it a timeout, bad input, rate limit, or LLM decision?

slides.title: What I would record
slides.body: Run ID, step ID, prompt version, model response, tool name, tool arguments, tool response, latency, token usage, error, and retry count.

slides.title: Debug before retrying
slides.body: Before you retry or resume, you need to inspect what happened. Otherwise you are mostly reading logs and guessing.

slides.title: Workshop focus
slides.body: We will talk about the execution layer around agents: state, retries, recovery, human approvals, observability, and deployment.
